title: Bound explicit Git exchange subprocesses on Windows
outcome: Bound explicit Git exchange subprocesses on Windows
acceptance: A purpose-specific Git exchange runner accepts only a pinned configured HTTPS destination and exact ref/operation, preserves the existing offline Git builder, launches Git directly without caller shell or interpolation of Engram-supplied values, and creates no SQLite, task-file, index or branch mutation outside the explicitly selected Git operation; Git's own allowlisted credential-helper shell path is confined to the same job, while SSH and every unsupported transport refuse before launch.

Owned Windows tests prove the Git process and every credential/SSH/helper descendant are inside a kill-on-close Job Object before they can escape, with deadline, cancellation, output-limit and failure cleanup that cannot hang on inherited pipes or leave descendants alive; unsupported controller admission fails closed.

HTTPS uses the user's existing supported Git credential facility without storing credentials; terminal, askpass and interactive helper prompts are disabled, output and redacted diagnostics are bounded, and unsupported helper/configuration refuses explicitly. SSH support belongs to a separate required transport slice and is not claimed by S0. Local fake-process/bare-remote tests state exactly which process and policy behavior they prove, without claiming real-network or cross-machine authentication.

No unsafe Engram code, global installation/configuration, TermAl relay, canonical SQLite/schema/projection or authority expansion is introduced; a short concrete controller/dependency and supported-credential design obtains Fable concurrence before implementation, with required project gates and independent reviews.

completion.summary: Delivered Windows-only bounded explicit HTTPS Git exchange infrastructure with configured target/helper admission, typed fixed operations, kill-on-close job ownership, bounded concurrent output/deadline/cancellation cleanup, shared service opt-in/read-only admission and owned real-process tests. All four unchanged acceptance criteria pass independent evaluation f1fbdc1544b4404580282b7dbb690672; full gate and current Codex/Claude pair cover the exact precommit source. Four Low roots remain, two block S1. No CLI/MCP exchange route or SSH/real-network authentication assurance.
